checkpoints.cite: OR III-II p.868, Vincent, 24 November 1862: army-command returns 527,679 pfd, 595,196 present, 775,336 present/absent; separate volunteer muster/pay-roll series 666,185 pfd, dates differ and many rolls are 31 October. [I] 500,000-700,000 is a broad review tolerance across these lagged duty series, not a confidence interval or proved endpoint bound. Regular aggregate 26,255 is not added as verified Regular pfd. Non-binding floor; no new run or calibration.

HOLD, not an accepted band: no complete November national pfd count established. L pp.41-47 explains mixed-date/incomplete Confederate returns; January 1863 is outside the window. OR I-XXI p.1025 and OR I-XX.2 p.412 cover partial commands with different measures and missing returns. [I] The schema permits min 0/max null, used solely as an explicit unbounded hold; it cannot satisfy a 1B men-under-arms acceptance criterion, prove zero or justify loading unknowns.
